summary.text: Jose Alvarez represents District 46, part of Osceola County, in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Alvarez was elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Alvarez is a real estate broker who lives in Kissimmee and moved to Florida in 1974.
Alvarez is a former HUD Regional Administrator, former Kissimmee city commissioner and former mayor of Kissimmee.
